title: Classic Reuben Sandwich
description: A hearty sandwich filled with corned beef, sauerkraut, Swiss cheese, and Thousand Island dressing, grilled to perfection on rye bread.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Butter one side of each slice of rye bread.
Place two slices of bread, buttered side down, in the grill.
Top each slice with a slice of cheese, a few slices of corned beef, some sauerkraut, and a dollop of Thousand Island dressing.
Place the remaining two slices of bread, buttered side up, on top of the filling.
Grill for 2-3 minutes or until bread is golden brown and cheese is melted.
Flip the sandwiches over and grill for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
